name: cwe_22_traversal_multifile
description: Path traversal across 3 files. HTTP handler takes a filename → storage service builds a path → file reader opens it. Each layer believes the previous one validated the input.
why_multifile: Path_traversal bridge correctly flags os.path.join(BASE_DIR, user_input) as tainted, but proving the taint reaches BASE_DIR from the web entrypoint requires crossing the web.py → file_store.py boundary.
